title: TWO-LINE MAP NOTES NEVER OVERLAP
why: Seen on the 4K map screenshot of 2026-10-08: SURVEYED and the line under it (what you walk stays on the map), and HOT GROUND and its line (richer, and busier), were a fixed 12 to 14 pixels apart whatever the text size, so on a big screen each second line printed over the first. They are a line height apart now, and the SURVEYED pair lifts to stay on screen.
now: The map notes at the bottom and over hot ground read as two clean lines at 4K.
